fields.name: Reserved
fields.description: Quantity reserved for open carts or orders.

fields.name: Damaged
fields.description: Quantity unavailable because it is damaged.

fields.name: Incoming
fields.description: Confirmed quantity expected from purchase orders or transfers.

fields.name: Blocked
fields.description: Quantity administratively withheld from sale (hold, recall, legal) but still physically present.

fields.name: Backordered
fields.description: Quantity sold beyond on-hand stock and owed to customers.

fields.name: InTransit
fields.description: Quantity dispatched on an outbound transfer, no longer on hand here and not yet received elsewhere.
